# Bank Customer Churn Analysis

## Import Libraries and Load Dataset

## Display Initial Records
```{python}
import pandas as pd
data=pd.read_csv("C:/Users/Udith P Kidiyoor/Downloads/Churn_Modelling.csv")
data.head(15)
```

## Explore Dataset Structure and Data Types
```{python}
data.info()
```

## Drop Identifier and Non-Predictive Columns
```{python}
data=data.drop(columns=["RowNumber","CustomerId","Surname","Gender"])
```

## Create Loyalty Feature
```{python}
data["Loyalty"]=data["Tenure"]/data["Age"]
data.head(10)
```

## Descriptive Statistics
```{python}
data.describe()
```

## Check Dataset Shape
```{python}
data.shape
```

## Check for Missing Values
```{python}
data.isna().sum()
```

## Separate Numerical and Categorical Variables
```{python}
numerical_features=[]
categorical_features=[]

for column, typ in data.dtypes.items():
    if typ=="int64" or typ=="float64":
        numerical_features.append(column)
    elif typ=="object":
        categorical_features.append(column)

numerical_features
categorical_features
```

## Import Visualization Libraries
```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
```

## Visualize Numerical Feature Distributions
```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(10,10))

for i, column in enumerate(numerical_features):
    plt.subplot(6,2,i+1)
    sns.histplot(data[column], color="pink", kde=True)
    plt.title(f"Distribution of {column}")
    plt.grid(True)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Analyze Outliers Using Box Plots
```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(10,10))

for i, column in enumerate(numerical_features):
    plt.subplot(6,2,i+1)
    sns.boxplot(data=data, x=column, color="yellow")
    plt.title(f"Distribution of {column}")
    plt.grid(True)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
data["Exited"].value_counts()
```

```{python}
data["Geography"].value_counts()
```

## Perform One-Hot Encoding
```{python}
data=pd.get_dummies(data, drop_first=True, dtype=int)
```
